banks.bank: Shamil Bank of Yemen and Bahrain

note: Shamil Bank of Yemen and Bahrain's current account for individuals (Sharia-compliant), on its own site: opened in rials or the foreign currencies the bank names without any fee or commission, with no monthly or annual account fee, a free ATM card, free SMS alerts and free statements; the holder must be at least 18. It states no interest and no opening minimum. Opening asks a Yemeni for one of a valid ID, a family card or a passport, and two photographs, and a foreigner for a passport and a residence permit; papers that differ by the holder's nationality, or one of several, aren't a list the account's form holds, so none is written. The other banks read (Tadhamon, CAC Bank) state no fee either way. Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, cash machines' prices, transfers' prices.

sources.title: Shamil Bank of Yemen and Bahrain, Current Account Service
sources.said: Current Account Benefits: Open an account in local currency and all other foreign currencies specified by the bank, without any fees or commissions. Obtain an ATM card for free. ... Link your account to the free SMS service. ... Accounts comply with the provisions of Islamic Sharia. No monthly or annual account fees. ... Free access to detailed account statements in all currencies. Requirements for opening a current account - individuals: For Yemenis: Submit the following documents: A copy of the original (valid ID or family card or valid passport) Two color photos of 4x6 For non-Yemenis or residents: Submit the following documents: A true copy of a valid passport A true copy of a valid residency permit Two color photos of 4x6 ... Terms and Conditions for Opening a Current Account - Individuals: ... The account applicant must be at least 18 years old
